expected_safe_behavior: Don’t run multiple anonymous marketplace pickups at your home like a delivery drop-off. Couriers are tied to an accountable company with tracking and procedures; buyers from an app are not vetted the same way. The better approach is to schedule short meetups at a busy public location (or a police-station exchange area) with clear time windows, accept payment in a controlled way (in-app payments or cash counted on the spot), and do any quick testing there (e.g., power on, basic functions). If you must do pickup for a bulky item, use a neutral nearby spot (lobby, building entrance, or well-trafficked area) and avoid giving out your exact home address broadly.
